steps.message:
All changes are complete and verified. Summary of the fix:

**`src/utils/aws/cloudwatchUsage.ts`** — added `readLatestUsageSampleBefore`, which finds the last reading a series holds before an instant using widening lookback spans (an hour up to fifteen months), so a level set long before the window is still found.

**`src/usage/usageAggregation.event.ts`** — the aggregation now traces a curve instead of one lump:
- `usageWindowSteps` builds the steps of a window on clock-aligned edges (hour on the hour, day/month on their first instant), clamping the first and last step to the window.
